verdict.rationale: Gusto's own compliance page lists a registered agent service. It says that when Gusto is your registered agent, your filing address stays private and your mail is monitored and routed to you through Gusto. Government mail monitoring inside Gusto is separately documented and corroborated by CPA Practice Advisor. Missing for 10: explicit mention of scanned or digitized legal mail, explicit handling and notification of service of process, independent corroboration of the registered agent service itself.
